question: Which government has announced the launch of the Mukhya Mantri Shramik Kalyan Yojana (MMSKY) as part of the National Labour Day celebrations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The MMSKY was launched on** November 19, 2021**, by the Chief Minister of **Arunachal Pradesh, Pema Khandu.**
 
• It aims to enhance the quality of life for workers by ensuring they have access to **healthcare, education, housing, and other essential services.**
 
• The scheme is implemented by the **Department of Labor & Employment, Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• As of 2024, The current **Chief Minister** of Arunachal Pradesh is **Pema Khandu**, and the current **Governor is Brigadier (Dr.) B.D. Mishra (Retd.).**
